### New Features and Capabilities

- Added image input support
- Experimental support for more Code CLI capabilities
  <img src="/_docs-assets/0304-more-cli.png" width="500px" />
- Added a one-click shortcut to fetch and process PR comments

### Feedback and Roadmap

- Launched the [Feedback Hub](https://feedback.lody.ai) for submitting feedback and viewing the product roadmap

### Usage Data and Context

- Added a time-based chart for token usage
- Restored the context window remaining-capacity indicator

<img src="/_docs-assets/0304-token-usage.png" width="600px" />

### Platform and UI Experience

- Updated Settings page UI
- Experimental desktop support for macOS and Windows

## Fixes and Stability

- Fixed occasional token billing miscounts
- Fixed incorrect defaults for project, repository, and model selection
- Fixed an issue where the chat input cursor could move unexpectedly
